sharedSource.sourceFinding: The pinned Hungarian Wikipedia revision identifies the Nagyatád–Somogyszob railway as MÁV line 38 and explicitly lists both Somogyszob and Nagyatád in its route diagram. The article cites Magyar Vasúttörténet volume 2 and dated railway-service material; no VPE/HÜSZ/KTI/GYSEV source lineage was found during the detailed line-level review.
sharedSource.caveat: The route diagram is explicit, but the individual station rows do not each carry a separate inline citation. This limitation is disclosed for human review and is not an automatic blocker under the current approved review policy.
